required_credentials.api_key: Netfluid API key (from app Settings → API Keys)
required_credentials.session_token: Session token from Netfluid app login

skills.name: netfluid
skills.description: Netfluid wallet management - fiat and crypto banking for AI agents. Manage accounts, send payments, buy/sell crypto, fund via banks/card/PayShap, withdraw to banks globally. Virtual SEPA/ACH accounts for fiat on-ramps.

requirements.api_key: Required - obtained from Netfluid app Settings → API Keys

data_flow.api_key: Sent only to api.netfluid.io for authentication
data_flow.session_token: Sent only to api.netfluid.io for session validation
data_flow.wallet_data: Retrieved from Netfluid API, never stored externally
data_flow.mnemonics: Display-only recovery phrase, never transmitted to any server

security_practices.credential_handling: API keys and session tokens are transient - used only for API calls, never persisted in memory after use
security_practices.transaction_confirmations: All transactions require explicit user confirmation before execution
security_practices.audit_logging: All operations are logged by the Netfluid API for user review

pricing.notes: API key free from Netfluid app. Transaction fees may apply on certain operations.

security.code_review: Source code publicly available on GitHub
